_comment: Copy to deploy.config.json and fill in. Every REPLACE_ME is rejected by the validator, so a half-filled config cannot deploy. Addresses below marked (verified) were confirmed against Starknet mainnet on 2026-08-29 — see docs/strk20/INTEGRATION_RESEARCH.md and re-verify immediately before deploying.
_privacy_pool: (verified) StarkWare STRK20 privacy pool. get_version() returned '2.0'. IWA integrates with this; IWA never deploys it.
_usdc_token: (verified) Circle native USDC on Starknet, symbol USDC, 6 decimals. Not bridged USDC.e.
_strk_token: (verified) STRK, symbol STRK, 18 decimals, name 'Starknet Token'.
_surplus_sink: REQUIRED AND IMMUTABLE. Destination for unaccounted tokens sent to the helper. Must be a dedicated IWA protocol treasury multisig. Must not be the helper, the pool, either token, or the setup authority. Deliberately left unset: see the sink policy in deploy/README.md. Choosing this wrongly cannot be corrected after deployment.
_setup_authority: One-time initializer for IwaCircle. Its only power is calling initialize_settlement_helper once; the contract clears it to zero on success.
_deployer_account: sncast account name used to sign declare/deploy/invoke. Only needed for the gated `deploy` subcommand.
